experiment: Prospective Q-Tensor prediction of IBM Kingston hardware
primary_hypothesis: The frozen calibration-informed Q-Tensor prediction will have lower TVD to IBM hardware than the ideal noiseless prediction for a majority of the preregistered circuits.
secondary_analysis: Report prediction error as CZ count increases; no post-hoc parameter fitting is permitted.
success_rule: TVD(Q-Tensor,IBM) < TVD(Ideal,IBM) on at least 3 of 4 circuits.
